Title: Mei Balance Patch #3
Subtitle: Balance Update
CleanedNotes:
=== General ===
[Updates]
  ARAM:
  • Leoric removed.
  • The Lost Vikings removed.
  Structures:
  • Towers, Forts, and Keeps
    • Damage to enemy Heroes increased by 10%.
  • Healing Fountains
    • Health and Shield values swapped.
    • Shield Regeneration rate increased to 10% of total Shields per second.

=== Heroes: Alexstrasza ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Circle of Life [W]
      • Regeneration Globe collection quest requirements reduced from 15/25 to 10/20.
  • Level 7
    • Verdant Flourish [W]
      • Healing for Alexstrasza increased from 30% to 40%.
  • Level 10
    • Life-Binder [R1]
      • Cooldown reduced from 60 to 50 seconds.
      • Mana cost reduced from 60 to 50.
  • Level 16
    • Tough Love [Q]
      • Armor bonus increased from 25 to 30.
    • Overprotective [W]
      • Shield amount increased from 60% to 70% of the amount healed.

=== Heroes: Ana ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Biotic Grenade [W]
    • Healing reduction duration reduced from 2 to 1.75 seconds.
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Slumber Shells [E]
      • Cooldown reduction on Sleep Dart reduced from 4 to 2 seconds.
  • Level 7
    • Anti-Healer [W]
      • Healing reduction duration bonus changed from 25% to .75 seconds.
    • Night Terrors [E]
      • Damage dealt reduced from 10% to 8% maximum Health.

=== Heroes: Anub'arak ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Health increased from 2100 to 2150.
  • Health Regeneration increased from 4.38 to 4.48.
  Talents:
  • Level 13
    • Level 13 talents have been changed to follow our normal talent ordering conventions.
    • Burning Beetles [Passive]
      • Damage dealt by Beetles reduced from 7 to 6.
  • Level 16
    • Debilitation [E]
      • Adjusted functionality: Enemy Heroes hit by Burrow Charge or Impale have their Spell Power reduced by 50% for 4 seconds.
    • Beetle, Juiced [Trait]
      • Adjusted functionality: Beetles gain 30% increased Health. Every 4th Basic Attack spawns a Beetle.

[Updates]

=== Heroes: D.Va ===
[Bug Fixes]

      • Meteor damage increased from 65 to 70.

      • No longer reduces the cooldown of Fire Stomp.
  • Level 13
    • Hellfire [W]
      • Bonus Spell Power per stack increased from 2% to 3%.
